card.name: The ending -able in chewable tablets
card.fires_on: The ending "able" in "chewable" when the next word is "tablet", mostly in dose lines for children. Weaker on the end of a few other long words such as "Precautions" and "PRESSAIR".

modes.label: chewable tablet
modes.description: The "able" ending of "chew" before "tablet" in pediatric dose lines or drug names.
modes.example: For pediatric patients 2 to 5 years of age: one 4-mg chew<<able>> tablet.

modes.label: Other word endings
modes.description: Weaker firing on the last part of other long words or names.
